profile.name: Rupesh Nepal
profile.bio: Backend developer working across Python, Rust, and Go. Currently at Hyteno Tech maintaining backend systems for Morgenland Teppiche — keeping product data consistent across their webshop and marketplace integrations. Previously built REST APIs and async systems at Shangrila Informatics and Ascend Crest Technologies. GNOME Nepal open source contributor.
profile.seoDescription: Backend developer specialising in Python, Rust and Go. Building scalable APIs, async systems, and open-source tools. GNOME Nepal contributor.

experience.highlight: Unified product data across 4+ marketplaces and leading ERP migration from Plentymarkets to Odoo.
details: Built a Shopify → central database sync pipeline, consolidating product and inventory data across eBay, Amazon, ManoMano, and Home24 into a single source of truth.
Implemented monthly dynamic pricing strategy across webshop channels to optimise sales performance and margins.
Maintained product data feeds for Google Shopping, Meta Catalog, and Pinterest Ads — ensuring feed accuracy for live ad campaigns and marketplace catalogs.
Orchestrated multi-marketplace catalog synchronisation using Channable, keeping listings consistent across 4+ sales channels.
Deployed and managed multiple production applications via Dokploy, reducing deployment overhead and improving operational visibility.
Leading ERP migration from Plentymarkets to Odoo, ensuring data integrity and continuity across the transition.

experience.highlight: Refactored legacy Django codebase and shipped async task pipelines with Celery/Redis.
details: Developed and maintained scalable REST APIs using Django and Django REST Framework (DRF).
Refactored legacy Django code to enhance performance and improve code readability.
Implemented clean architecture and consistent coding standards.
Implemented data import/export functionalities using pyopenxl and Django Import-Export.
Utilized pyopenxl to generate Excel reports with advanced patterns.
Integrated asynchronous background tasks with Celery/Redis.
Built and managed containerized applications with Docker.

experience.highlight: Built BetzBazar — C2C beats marketplace with SOX audio watermarking, Stripe payments, and real-time WebSockets.
details: Built the backend for BetzBazar, a C2C music beats marketplace, using Django and Django REST Framework.
Implemented SOX-based audio watermarking — overlaying beat samples with an inaudible background sound on preview playback, making raw samples un-pirateable before purchase.
Integrated Stripe payment gateway for beat licensing transactions, handling one-time purchases and license tier management.
Added real-time features with Django Channels WebSockets (live notifications, purchase confirmations).
Set up Celery/Redis async task pipeline for audio processing jobs and background task handling.
Built CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions, deployed on AWS EC2 with Gunicorn/Flower and Cloudflare/R2 for audio file storage.

experience.highlight: Maintainer of GNOME Nepal's Django backend and contributor to Djate, a production-ready Django template.
details: Major Contributor and Maintainer of the GNOME Nepal Backend System (Django).
Contributed to 'Djate', a production-ready Django project template used by the community.
Collaborated with open source contributors across Nepal to build and maintain community infrastructure.
Reviewed pull requests, triaged issues, and mentored new contributors to the Django ecosystem.
Taught students about Linux and the GNOME desktop as a workshop instructor.

experience.highlight: Operations Lead for UbuCon Asia 2025 — ran event operations and social media.
details: Operations Lead for UbuCon Asia 2025, hosted by Ubuntu Nepal.
Ran on-ground event operations across the multi-day conference.
Ran the event's social media campaign throughout UbuCon Asia 2025.
